paper_title: On Congruences Related to Central Binomial Coefficients
text:
\begin{lemma}
Let the Euler numbers $E_j$ be defined by the exponential generating function
\[
\frac{1}{\cosh t}=\sum_{j=0}^{\infty}E_j\frac{t^j}{j!}.
\]
If $p>3$ is a prime, then
\[
\sum_{k=1}^{\lfloor p/6\rfloor}\frac{(-1)^k}{k^2}
\equiv (-1)^{(p-1)/2}10E_{p-3}\pmod p.
\]
\end{lemma}
